schema.name: USG Neutral Building Specification
schema.purpose: Software-neutral machine-readable description of Building 002 reconstructed from a hand sketch and user confirmations. Intended to let another AI generate concept geometry without access to the original conversation.

evidence_classes.exact: Explicitly dimensioned in the sketch or directly confirmed by the user. Binding.
evidence_classes.derived: Mathematically derived from exact information without adding unsupported design intent. Binding.
evidence_classes.observed: Presence or topology is visible in the sketch, but exact geometry is not fully dimensioned.
evidence_classes.approximate: Geometry may be reconstructed proportionally from the sketch for concept output only.
evidence_classes.ambiguous: More than one materially different interpretation remains possible.
evidence_classes.unknown: No reliable information exists; leave unresolved.

schema.core_rule: Dimensions override proportion. Proportion fills gaps. User confirmation resolves ambiguity.

project.name: Sketch Building 002
project.source: Hand sketch supplied by the user on 2026-10-26, showing plan and perspective on one sheet

origin.location: top-left corner of the lower rectangular plan as drawn

coordinate_system.note: Sketch axes are local drawing coordinates only and must not be interpreted as geographic directions.

level_height_mm.source: 3.0 m sketch dimension confirmed by user as level height

upper_roof_top_level_mm.source: 6.0 m sketch dimension confirmed by user as second-level roof-top elevation

flat_roof_overhang_mm.source: 1.0 m sketch dimension confirmed by user as flat roof overhang

glazing_segment_width_mm.source: user confirmation that glazing is divided into 1 m segments

footprint.placement_relative_to_lower_box: visible in perspective and implied by four upper column markers, but exact plan geometry is not dimensioned

upper_box.rule: Upper box geometry may be proportionally reconstructed from the sketch for a concept model, but its dimensions and coordinates must remain tagged approximate.

roof_terrace.description: Accessible roof terrace on top of level 1. The railing visible in the perspective runs around the terrace edge.

guard_or_railing.rule: Do not invent a code-compliant guard height unless generating an explicitly labeled visualization hypothesis.

lower_box.logic: one marker at each corner of the lower box
lower_box.coordinate_note: Coordinates represent column marker centers at lower-box corners for neutral concept reconstruction.

upper_box.logic: one marker at each corner of the upper box
upper_box.coordinate_note: Exact upper-box footprint is unresolved, so upper column coordinates must be derived only after an approximate upper-box footprint is chosen.

glazing.facade_character: large ground-level glazed openings composed in 1 m segments
glazing.rule: Use 1 m horizontal modules where glazing is shown, but do not invent exact start/end positions or heights unless they are explicitly tagged approximate.

stairs.location_description: Near the upper middle-right portion of the plan, adjacent to the small L-shaped core/wall condition.
stairs.role: Likely access between level 1 and roof terrace/upper level, but exact geometry is unresolved.

internal_core_or_wall.location_description: Near stair in upper middle-right portion of plan.

roofs.shape_description: Perspective suggests a sloping roof over the upper box.

roofs.note: The 1 m dimension applies to the flat roof overhang.

unresolved.impact: controls upper columns, roof footprint, terrace residual area and façade alignment

unresolved.item: upper box exact placement on lower box
upper roof pitch and exact edge geometry
roof terrace exact boundary and railing offset
stair width, run, risers and exact coordinates
glazing opening heights and exact façade extents
external wall thickness, internal wall thickness and material assemblies

hard_rules: Preserve the lower-box footprint at 10000 x 8000 mm.
Preserve the level height at 3000 mm.
Preserve the upper roof-top elevation at 6000 mm.
Preserve the flat-roof overhang at 1000 mm where that roof condition is modeled.
Use eight 300 x 300 mm column markers: four lower-box corners and four upper-box corners.
Use 1000 mm glazing modules where glazing is represented.
Include the roof terrace over level 1 with a perimeter railing where shown.
Do not silently convert approximate geometry into exact geometry.
Do not fabricate precise stair geometry, roof pitch, glazing heights, or upper-box dimensions as if they were source facts.
allowed_approximation: upper-box width, depth and XY placement may be proportionally estimated from the perspective
upper roof pitch may be estimated from the perspective
terrace boundary may be inferred as the remaining level-1 roof area outside the upper box
stair location and overall envelope may be approximated from the plan
glazing module placement may follow the visual façade rhythm

required_metadata_on_export.subject: design_hypothesis
must_list: all unresolved source items not built

success_criteria: A human viewing the model should recognize the same two-level composition shown in the sketch.
The lower 10 x 8 m box, level heights, roof terrace, eight-column logic, 1 m glazing rhythm and 1 m overhang must be preserved.
Any guessed geometry must remain identifiable as approximate in the export metadata.

usg_state.human_acceptance_required_before: promotion of approximate geometry beyond concept-hypothesis status
